set.content[68].children[2].text: (often called SaaS) is the ride-sharing option. You pay a subscription fee—usually monthly or annually—to access the software over the internet. The vendor takes care of all the servers, security, and updates behind the scenes. This model gives you lower upfront costs and the freedom to access your business data from anywhere with an internet connection. For a deeper look at this choice, our guide on (https://kpinfo.tech/insights/on-premise-vs-cloud-erp/).
